tasks.title: Announcement #37
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a university classroom.
tasks.transcript: Since a lot of you have expressed an interest in a career in education once you've graduated, I thought I'd share something that I think will be very helpful to you. It's a list of professional organizations and networking opportunities for aspiring new teachers. I've attached a copy with an e-mail I sent everyone just before class. If you're one of the students I'm referring to, I highly recommend you check it out.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To recommend a book about networking
options.B: To inform students about a list of resources
options.C: To emphasize the importance of a career in education
options.D: To explain the process of joining professional organizations

questions.analysis: 答案: B 题目问的是: 这个公告的目的是？ 定位原文: “It's a list of professional organizations and networking opportunities for aspiring new teachers.” 选项分析: A. “To recommend a book about networking.”（推荐一本关于建立联系的书。）公告没有提到推荐书籍，因此A选项错误。 B. “To inform students about a list of resources.”（告知学生关于一份资源清单。）公告的确是关于向学生提供资源信息，因此B选项正确。 C. “To emphasize the importance of a career in education.”（强调教育职业的重要性。）虽然提到了教育职业，但这不是公告的主要目的，因此C选项错误。 D. “To explain the process of joining professional organizations.”（解释加入专业组织的过程。）公告没有详细说明加入的过程，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the professor imply when he says, "I've attached a copy with an email I sent everyone just before class"?

options.A: Students are able to access a document.
options.B: He cannot meet with students before class.
options.C: Students should check their email regularly.
options.D: Emails are his preferred method of communication.

questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 教授说“我在课前给大家发了一封邮件，并附上了一份副本”，教授暗示了什么？ 定位原文: “I've attached a copy with an email I sent everyone just before class.” 选项分析: A. “Students are able to access a document.”（学生可以访问一份文件。）这是教授说的内容，表明学生能通过邮件获得文档，因此 A 选项正确。 B. “He cannot meet with students before class.”（他在课前不能与学生见面。）原文没有涉及这个话题，因此 B 选项错误。 C. “Students should check their email regularly.”（学生应该定期检查邮件。）虽然教授发送了邮件，但并未明确要求学生定期检查邮件，因此 C 选项错误。 D. “Emails are his preferred method of communication.”（电子邮件是他首选的沟通方式。）原文没有提到教授偏好电子邮件，因此 D 选项错误。
